nodes.label: Dry Hire Rental Paradigm
nodes.source_location: ### Fleet Rental Paradigms and Financial Modeling
nodes.rationale: Locks physical machinery only; client provides operator; fixed daily/weekly rate. Structurally decoupled from Wet Hire for accurate quoting and resource locking.

nodes.label: Wet Hire Rental Paradigm
nodes.source_location: ### Fleet Rental Paradigms and Financial Modeling
nodes.rationale: Locks machinery AND certified human operator; provider retains risk and compliance; combined hourly rate. Requires dual-resource lock and operator certification verification.

nodes.label: VMRS — Vehicle Maintenance Reporting Standards
nodes.source_location: ### Standard Repair Times and VMRS Integration
nodes.rationale: Nine-digit ATA coding standard mapped to Standard Repair Times (SRT) so dispatch durations are algorithmically derived, not guessed. Vehicle Difficulty Factor applied as multiplier.

nodes.label: OptaPlanner / Timefold AI Scheduling Solver
nodes.rationale: Solves VRPTW + Multi-skill Task Assignment via metaheuristics (Tabu Search, Simulated Annealing). Hard constraints prevent illegal assignments; soft constraints minimize travel and balance load. Shadow Variables cascade arrival times.

nodes.label: MQTT Broker (Field Telemetry Protocol)
nodes.source_location: ### Real-Time Network Protocols: MQTT vs. WebSockets
nodes.rationale: Chosen over WebSockets for mobile-to-backend because of broker-centric pub/sub, QoS levels (0/1/2), and resilience on intermittent cellular. WebSockets remain optimal for browser dashboard.

nodes.label: Flutter Mobile App (Mechanic Field App)
nodes.rationale: Dart cross-platform for iOS and Android. Adaptive GPS polling: high rate when EN_ROUTE, low rate when IN_PROGRESS. Clean Architecture + GetX state management + Hive offline cache.

nodes.label: PostGIS Spatial Database (ST_Point, KNN queries)
nodes.source_location: ## Backend Architecture: Java, Quarkus, and Vert.x
nodes.rationale: Complex geo queries at DB level not app memory. Geofences, KNN mechanic proximity, ST_Point for mechanic and vehicle locations. GIST index for <-> operator.
